commands_run: clan patch-decision branches\customer-discovery.clan --agent customer-discovery --action "Added team-adoption analysis ... recommended_vendor=HubSpot (confidence 4/5)" --rationale "..."
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force snapshots, receipts; Copy-Item work\branches\customer-discovery.clan snapshots\branch-customer-discovery.clan -Force
problems_and_friction: No protocol was provided, so I had to discover the CLI contract myself; clan agent-help and the embedded agent guide in 'clan read agent' made this straightforward. The task brief declares output mode full-html, but as a branch agent I can only write to my namespace via patch-data, so I contributed structured data and left rendering to the synthesizer - a guided protocol would have removed that ambiguity. The output schema in the branch was effectively unconstrained (type: object), so I had to invent a sensible key structure and hope it merges cleanly with sibling branches.
context_understood: I was one of three parallel branch agents on a CRM evaluation (Salesforce vs HubSpot vs Zoho) for a 40-person Dublin ad agency; my job was to write the team-adoption analysis (learning curves, training burden, resistance, change management) plus a recommended_vendor pick into my forked .clan branch using the clan CLI so a synthesizer can merge it.
